attributeDefinitions.information_access: Which substantive information is available, when it is available, or who can observe it; distinguish from accuracy.
attributeDefinitions.information_dependence: Shared sources, overlapping signals or correlated errors, holding marginal accuracy distinct.
attributeDefinitions.interpretation_compatibility: Common vocabulary, data formats, interpretive constraints or ability to reconcile the same evidence.
attributeDefinitions.verification_process: Cost, effort or procedure of checking evidence or actions; preserve any fixed verification level.
attributeDefinitions.feedback_timing: When consequences or diagnostic feedback become observable, rather than how often X changes.
attributeDefinitions.coordination_constraints: Compatibility, synchronized choices, matching requirements or reciprocal adjustment dependence.
attributeDefinitions.adjustment_scope: The number or allocation of tasks/parties that must revise operations, distinct from compatibility itself.
attributeDefinitions.work_distribution: How a fixed total burden is distributed across parties.
attributeDefinitions.choice_defaults: Initialization, defaults or established conventions with choice rights held explicit.
attributeDefinitions.implementation_latency: Time between an available decision and its implementation or certification.
attributeDefinitions.decision_windows: Deadlines, decision frequency, meeting calendars or available time for adjustment.
attributeDefinitions.reversibility: Recoverability or restoration expense after a commitment, distinct from detecting its consequences.
attributeDefinitions.transition_continuity: Whether incumbent operations can continue during replacement, qualification or transition.
attributeDefinitions.exit_cost: Losses or costs associated with leaving an arrangement, distinct from temporary interruption.
attributeDefinitions.resource_slack: Spare capacity, buffers, staffing or resource availability.
attributeDefinitions.incentive_alignment: Compatibility of interests, compensation opportunities or distributive preferences.
attributeDefinitions.authority_allocation: Who can decide, veto or authorize an action; preserve fixed governance definitions.
attributeDefinitions.knowledge_continuity: Retention or transfer of role-specific experience through handovers, records or briefing.
attributeDefinitions.routine_reuse: Recurrence that permits procedures or administrative routines to be reused.
attributeDefinitions.communication_access: Communication channels, meeting access or communication costs.
attributeDefinitions.enforcement_reach: Who can apply consequences once a violation is established, distinct from detecting it.
attributeDefinitions.enforcement_latency: Delay in obtaining a remedy after evidence exists.
attributeDefinitions.external_approval: Outside authorization requirements or approval procedures.
attributeDefinitions.experimentation_cost: Cost, scale or opportunity to trial an option before commitment.
attributeDefinitions.disruption_stakes: Consequences of interruption or mismatch, distinct from its likelihood.
